Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Tobi
Message:
fix: poll Circle for async txHash in Blend multisend executor

Circle contract executions return asynchronously with empty txHash
while INITIATED/QUEUED. The old code returned immediately, Blend
received an empty hash, couldn't match the on-chain tx, and the
session expired with 'signing inactivity'.

Added pollForTxHash that polls GetTransaction every 3s for up to 2
minutes until the real hash appears or the tx fails. Also added a
recovery script to reset the .108 stranded redemption.
